title: 第九章紫电镭射炮第十章不要命的人类疯子
content_zh:
苏阳闻言，不由倒吸了一口凉气。
心想，若是真能收服这头紫电狂狮，自己的复仇大计，的确会容易许多。
这玩意，对付王朗应该问题不大。
至于王依依，苏阳肯定要亲手将其解决，夺回属于自己的至尊之血了。
“我要如何做？”苏阳回应道。
“那好不好办？淦他就完事了，先让这头妖兽感受到你强大的战斗力，让它被你的气势所臣服，到时候本大圣自有办法，让这头紫电狂狮乖乖听话。”
“......”
还不等苏阳回应，眼前的紫电狂狮已经开始出击了，匍匐的身躯纵身一跃，巨大的厉爪犹如撕裂虚空般，抓向苏阳。
苏阳爆发灵气，将手里长棍抵在胸膛之前。
轰的一声，一股极强的力量通过木棍传入苏阳的双臂之中。
酥麻之感，顿时遍布全身。
强大的冲击力，也让苏阳的身躯倒飞了数米，好在及时稳住了身形。
“艹！”苏阳怒骂一声，灵气爆发而出，手持着被灵气笼罩的长棍，反击而去。
巨大棍影，朝天一击，猛然落下。
紫电狂狮的反应速度也极快，苏阳一棍落空，前者再度发出怒吼，厉爪扑向苏阳的头颅而去。
苏阳将长棍扔向天空，斗战圣法开启，双拳紧握，万斤之力遍布全身。
“喝！！”面对紫电狂狮的厉爪，苏阳猛然出拳。
直接开始肉体对碰。
砰！
一拳一爪轰在一起，爆发出阵阵罡风。

紫电狂狮的瞳孔不由发生变化，它估计也没想到，眼前这看似弱小的人类，居然敢与自己肉体碰撞？而且，还丝毫不落下风？.
王者之姿让其不由恼怒。
“吼~！”
又是一道狂吼，紫电狂狮再度爆发出惊人的妖气，使得苏阳此刻不由神情扭曲起来。
"喝！"苏阳也用尽全力，将肉体之力运用到极致，强大的战斗气息爆发而出。瞬间将紫电狂狮，轰飞而出！！！
紫电狂狮急忙煽动翅膀，让自己稳住体型，稳稳落在地上，只是没有再度发动攻击，而是继续匍匐着身躯，死死盯着苏阳。
苏阳刚才已经用了大部分力气，但却并没有对紫电狂狮造成实质性的伤害，可眼里的凶狠之色，丝毫没有减弱。
依旧紧握拳头，作出攻击姿态。
“吼~”
似乎是觉得自己遭到了眼前人类的蔑视，紫电狂狮咆哮一声，本就发紫的毛发在这一刻发出闪电之声。
自己好歹是堂堂六品妖兽，岂会被一个弱小人类蔑视？
一定要将其撕碎！！！
苏阳简直，知晓这头六品妖兽要动用妖兽技能，也不敢大意，急忙捡起长棍，灵气肆虐而出。
“弱小的人类，你该死！！”
content_en:
Su Yang couldn't help but take a breath when he heard this.
He thought to himself that if he could really subdue this purple lightning lion, his revenge plan would indeed be much easier.
This thing shouldn't be a big problem against Wang Lang.
As for Wang Yiyi, Su Yang will definitely solve it with his own hands and take back his own supreme blood.
"What should I do?" Su Yang responded.
"Is that easy to do? He's done with it. First, let this monster feel your powerful fighting power and let it surrender to your aura. When the time comes, I will have my own way to make this purple electric lion obedient."
"..."
Before Su Yang could respond, the purple electric lion in front of him had already begun to attack. Its crawling body jumped up, and its huge sharp claws grabbed Su Yang as if tearing through the void.
Su Yang burst out with spiritual energy and put the long stick in his hand in front of his chest.
With a bang, an extremely strong force was transmitted into Su Yang's arms through the wooden stick.
A numbing feeling suddenly spread all over the body.
The powerful impact also caused Su Yang's body to fly backwards for several meters, but fortunately, he stabilized his body in time.
"Fuck!" Su Yang cursed angrily, and his spiritual energy burst out. He held a long stick enveloped in spiritual energy and fought back.
The huge stick shadow struck the sky and fell suddenly.
The Purple Lightning Crazy Lion's reaction speed was also extremely fast. Su Yang's stick missed, and the former roared again, and pounced on Su Yang's head with its sharp claws.
Su Yang threw the long stick into the sky, activated the holy fighting method, clenched his fists, and tens of thousands of pounds of power spread throughout his body.
"Drink!!" Facing the sharp claws of the Purple Lightning Lion, Su Yang punched suddenly.
The physical contact started directly.
Bang!
One punch and one claw struck together, bursting out bursts of strong wind.
The pupils of the Purple Lightning Crazy Lion couldn't help but change. It probably didn't expect that the seemingly weak human in front of it actually dared to physically collide with itself? Moreover, he didn’t fall behind at all? .
His majestic appearance made him angry.
"Ho~!"
With another roar, the Purple Lightning Crazy Lion once again burst out with astonishing demonic energy, making Su Yang's expression distorted at this moment.
"Drink!" Su Yang also tried his best, using his physical strength to the extreme, and a powerful fighting aura burst out. In an instant, the purple lightning mad lion flew out! ! !
The purple electric lion hurriedly flapped its wings to steady itself and landed firmly on the ground. However, it did not launch another attack. Instead, it continued to crouch and stared at Su Yang.
Su Yang had used most of his strength just now, but it did not cause any substantial damage to the Purple Lightning Lion, but the ferocious look in his eyes did not weaken at all.
Still clenching his fists, making an attacking stance.
"Roar~"
As if feeling that he was being despised by the humans in front of him, the Purple Lightning Lion roared, and its already purple hair made the sound of lightning at this moment.
After all, I am a dignified sixth-grade monster, how can I be looked down upon by a weak human being?
Be sure to shred it! ! !
Su Yang simply knew that this sixth-level monster was going to use monster skills, but he didn't dare to be careless. He hurriedly picked up the long stick and unleashed aura.
"Weak human being, you deserve to die!!"
